description: A light wooden tabletop is in front of you with a white round base piece and a small white cross-shaped post lying to the right. The right hand reaches to the right, grasps the cross-shaped post as a right-hand object, lifts and brings it left over the round base while the left hand hovers nearby, then both hands guide the post down into the center opening and twist/press to seat it before releasing so it stands upright on the base.
